comment: The definition is marked [Under review]. As drafted it groups all end-user applications together, but the obligations that follow differ sharply depending on whether an application writes to the shared record or only reads from it. A system that writes into the Lifelong Health Record inherits conformance, provenance and data-quality duties that a read-only viewer does not.

public.text: The definition is marked [Under review]. As drafted it groups all end-user applications together, but the obligations that follow differ sharply depending on whether an application writes to the shared record or only reads from it. A system that writes into the Lifelong Health Record inherits conformance, provenance and data-quality duties that a read-only viewer does not.
public.suggestedRevision: Revise to distinguish point-of-service applications that write to shared infrastructure from those that only consume it, and state that the former carry conformance and provenance obligations defined by the architecture.
